name: decrement_strong_count_in
declaration: unsafe fn decrement_strong_count_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A)
rules: The pointer must have been obtained through Rc::into_raw.
The pointer must satisfy the layout requirements specified in Rc::from_raw_in.
The associated Rc instance must be valid, with a strong count of at least 1, when invoking this method.
The pointer must point to a block of memory allocated by alloc.
This method must not be called after the final Rc has been released.
